complexityManagement.behavior: Use named synchronized views scoped by semantic purpose instead of a single all-elements canvas.
Major containers support collapsed, summary, and expanded modes with counts and exposed ports.
Far zoom shows containers and counts; mid zoom shows cards and ports; near zoom shows compartments and edge labels.
Containment, structural, behavioral, policy, trace, readiness, and generated edges are independently filterable.
Selecting an element can focus a depth-1 or depth-2 neighborhood and fade unrelated nodes.
Search indexes names, ids, tags, source refs, routes, event names, logical ids, and AWS types where present.
EVL/readiness findings appear as markers and sortable issue lists that highlight affected elements.
Trace links remain a separate layer with confidence filters.
Views persist filters, layout, camera positions, and edge-layer choices.

universalSyntax.notation: Rounded large frame with title bar and optional swimlane/header.
universalSyntax.interaction: Spatial containment changes containment or membership only when valid.

universalSyntax.notation: Rounded card with title, stereotype token, badges, and collapsible compartments.
universalSyntax.interaction: Primary attributes are shown inline; secondary attributes remain editable in the inspector.

universalSyntax.notation: Meaning-specific CMD, QRY, EVT, ERR, condition, state, and process-step shapes.
universalSyntax.interaction: Shape and token carry meaning without relying on color alone.

universalSyntax.notation: Labeled line with arrowheads, endpoint roles, and multiplicity where available.
universalSyntax.interaction: Dense edge layers are hidden, bundled, or exposed through focus mode.

universalSyntax.notation: Compact linked-element chip inside a card compartment or inspector row.
universalSyntax.interaction: Clicking a chip navigates to or highlights the referenced element.

kernelSyntax.notation: Hidden metadata layer with lifecycle, generated, rationale, review, and trace badges.
Key-value chips attached to a card or listed in an annotations tab.
Separate traceability overlay with dashed labeled links and confidence filtering.
Expandable expression or document editor with compact card badge.
Readiness board and severity markers on affected elements.
